own_solution.law: Partially filled parallel-plate capacitor C = eps0 A / (d - t + t/kappa) = C0 d / (d - t(1 - 1/kappa)); at fixed V, dQ = (C - C0) V
assumptions: battery remains connected so V fixed

notes: C = 100 pF x 6/(6 - 3 x 0.75) = 600/3.75 = 160 pF; dQ = 60 pF x 12 V = 720 pC = 0.72 nC. With a 7.5 V cell in series aiding the battery (connected before first charging and, by implication, still in place), V = 19.5 V and dQ = 60 x 19.5 = 1170 pC. T9341 and T6AD3 read as the cell remaining in the circuit; a reader might wonder whether it was later removed, but 'was connected ... before' with nothing about removal implies it stays. Earlier-experiment-only cell and cells on the lamp's battery are D. 'Small cell' sentences carry no number (apparent numeral-free controls).
